hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -q 'backend/src/db\.ts$' && printf '
⚠️  backend/src/db.ts was just modified.
If this changed the schema (initSchema): CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS does NOT add new columns/tables to an EXISTING backend/taskflow.db. Delete backend/taskflow.db* (or run scripts/reset.sh) before restarting the dev server -- otherwise you will hit confusing 'no such column' errors against a stale database.
' >&2 || true
